verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an observability platform, but the evidence pack never documents bulk actions across many items, such as bulk-editing rules, cases, alerts or SLOs, or a bulk API. Fleet's central agent management and ES|QL querying across large datasets are adjacent features, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
